blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The self-confessed killer in the Isaac Viernes murder case is out of jail after posting bail in two separate pending criminal cases not related to the murder of Isaac Viernes. The suspect is out despite active warrants for attempted murder and illegal possession of firearms, which are separate cases not linked to the Viernes killing. Police Lieutenant Colonel Gerard Ace Pelare, deputy city director for operations of the Cebu City Police Office, said investigators on the case confirmed that the self-confessed killer, whom police gave the alyas “Eco,” was out on bail.
